figures.Fig-bar: Bar chart showing relative abundance of insect species in a local forest. Original figure archived as c12-bio-ch22-fig-bar-chart (drawn for this lesson; not the textbook's picture).

findings: The printed chart's y-axis reads 'Abundance (%)' but is scaled 0 to 140 like the counts; the original chart plots counts and labels percentages. The percentages (of 290 insects) were checked.
